summary: FST Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting entry into an At-The-Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC to sell up to $10.4 million of ordinary shares from time to time. The filing also notes a corrected prospectus supplement filed July 6, 2026, superseding an inadvertently filed original. Sales will occur on Nasdaq at prevailing market prices; the agent receives 3.0% compensation. This is a routine at-the-market shelf takedown, not a special situation. No unusual recommendation, premium, or event is involved; it is a standard equity distribution facility.
